# Brick placement from ASSS 1.4.4 src/core/mapdata.c FindBrickEndpoints (compiled
# unmodified), driven as src/core/bricks.c drives it. Maps: vectors/gen_synth_maps.py.
# brick <map> <mode> <dropx> <dropy> <direction> <length> <coin> <result>
#   mode 0 VIE, 1 AHEAD, 2 LATERAL, 3 CAGE; direction is the ship rotation 0..39.
#   coin is the next prng->Get32() value (VIE mode uses bit 0 when no wall is within
#   `length`; every other mode ignores it, and those lines are emitted once with coin 0).
#   result is `blocked` when the drop tile is solid (the only FALSE return), else one
#   `x1,y1,x2,y2` for modes 0-2 and four space-separated ones for CAGE.
# NOTE: ASSS returns TRUE for CAGE and for unknown modes via its `failed` label; only a
#   solid drop tile gives FALSE.
